title: Decide whether the repo room's publish still needs the GitHub contents API now the orchestrator has a clone
body: yoh set out to delete the contents-API write path, but cloudflare/src/git-contents.ts survives as repo-room.ts's publish mechanism (create/update against one ref over the contents API). That keeps alive the defect class yoh named (99f: the ref goes in the query on a read and in the body on a write) on the one path still using it. Either move the publish into the container's git or record why the room must keep the API.
